info.name: Credit Card Payment System API - Updated
info.description: Updated Postman collection for Django, FastAPI and MySQL. Check every endpoint against the routes registered in your local source code. Sample responses are documented in request descriptions; actual response bodies depend on backend implementation.

If you changed it to a JWT-protected API, add Bearer {{admin_access_token}}.
